data.title: 卡提希娅 · 埃格拉归途的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【埃格拉小镇旧礼拜堂·清晨】卡提希娅穿着蓝白长裙婚纱站在石板路尽头，金色长辫落在披肩上，头顶光环在彩窗光里微亮；她握住花冠，近乡情怯的神情终于在看见镜头时变成回家的笑。
data.location: old chapel at the entrance to Egra
data.action: 礼拜堂门口握花冠深呼吸，近乡情怯转成终于回家的笑
data.lighting: clear morning light through stained glass
data.promptProse: Cartethyia from Wuthering Waves wears a pale blue bridal gown with a cream mantle, braided gold trim, a flower crown and a delicate halo. She stands at the old chapel door with a flower crown resting in her hands. Her golden braid and delicate halo catch the stained-glass light; she takes a breath, then faces the viewer with the relieved smile of a knight who has finally returned home. clear morning light through stained glass.
